rationale: The tape is genuinely two-sided five minutes in: a +12% gap opened at the high of day, flushed to 7.63 on the heaviest volume bar, then recovered above VWAP on steadily declining volume and is now stalling mid-range (53.8%) below the open — a structure that supports both a shakeout continuation and a gap fade. With no identifiable catalyst, a risk-off tape (SPY -0.72%, VIXY +3.38%) arguing against longs while the VWAP reclaim argues against shorts, and a 26bp spread consuming roughly a third of the 5-minute ATR in friction, there is no directional edge worth paying for at this location.
